queries.text:
SELECT id, title, embedding <=> $1::vector AS distance
FROM document
WHERE station_id = $2
ORDER BY distance
LIMIT $3
queries.name: NearestDocuments

queries.text:
WITH claimed AS (
  SELECT id FROM job
  WHERE state = 'queued' AND run_after <= now()
  ORDER BY run_after, id
  LIMIT $2
  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
)
UPDATE job
SET state = 'running', claimed_by = $1::text, claimed_at = now(), attempts = job.attempts + 1
FROM claimed
WHERE job.id = claimed.id
RETURNING job.id, job.kind, job.payload, job.attempts, job.claimed_at
queries.name: ClaimJobs
comments: Claims up to batch_size queued jobs that are due, skipping any another worker holds.

queries.text:
INSERT INTO daily_peak (station_id, day, metric, peak, updated_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, now())
ON CONFLICT (station_id, day, metric) DO UPDATE
SET peak = GREATEST(daily_peak.peak, EXCLUDED.peak),
  samples = daily_peak.samples + 1,
  updated_at = now()
RETURNING id, station_id, day, metric, peak, samples, updated_at
queries.name: RecordPeak
comments: Keeps the highest value seen for a station's metric on a day.

queries.text:
SELECT station_id, metric, COUNT(*)::int AS days, MAX(updated_at) AS last_updated,
  COALESCE(SUM(samples), 0)::bigint AS total_samples
FROM daily_peak
WHERE day >= $1
GROUP BY station_id, metric
ORDER BY station_id, metric
queries.name: PeakSummary

queries.text:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (station_id, metric) id, station_id, metric, value, recorded_at, note
FROM reading
WHERE station_id = ANY($1::int[])
ORDER BY station_id, metric, recorded_at DESC
queries.name: LatestReadings
comments: The latest reading of each metric, for each station asked for.

queries.text:
WITH RECURSIVE ancestry AS (
  SELECT id, parent_id FROM region WHERE id = $2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.id, r.parent_id FROM region r JOIN ancestry a ON r.id = a.parent_id
)
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ancestry WHERE id = $1) AS within
queries.name: IsWithinRegion

queries.text:
SELECT s.id, s.name, a.enabled AS alerts_enabled, a.level AS alert_level, d.theme, d.compact,
  y.id IS NOT NULL AS has_sync, y.interval_minutes
FROM station s
LEFT JOIN station_alert_config a ON a.station_id = s.id
LEFT JOIN station_display_config d ON d.station_id = s.id
LEFT JOIN station_sync_config y ON y.station_id = s.id
ORDER BY s.name, s.id
queries.name: ListStations
comments: Every station with its alert, display and sync settings, any of which it may lack.

queries.text:
SELECT s.id, s.name, s.region_id,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.region_id ORDER BY s.created_at, s.id) AS position
FROM station s
WHERE s.name = ANY($1::text[])
ORDER BY s.region_id, position
queries.name: RankStationsByName
